tasks.name: Design UI for Calculator
tasks.description: Create a user interface for the calculator with buttons for numbers and operations.

tasks.name: Implement Addition Functionality
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to perform addition of two numbers.

tasks.name: Implement Subtraction Functionality
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to perform subtraction of two numbers.

tasks.name: Implement Multiplication Functionality
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to perform multiplication of two numbers.

tasks.name: Implement Division Functionality
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to perform division of two numbers.

tasks.name: Integrate UI with Backend
tasks.description: Connect the frontend UI with the backend logic to perform operations.

tasks.name: Test Calculator Operations
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure all arithmetic operations work correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy Calculator Application
tasks.description: Deploy the application to a server or hosting platform.

T1.implementation_approach: Use a design tool like Figma or Adobe XD to create wireframes and mockups for the calculator UI. Ensure the design is user-friendly and includes buttons for numbers, operations, and a display area.
T1.notes: Focus on usability and accessibility in the design.

T2.implementation_approach: Implement a function that takes two numbers as input and returns their sum. Ensure the function handles edge cases like large numbers and non-numeric inputs.
T2.notes: Consider using JavaScript, Python, or any language suitable for the backend.

T3.implementation_approach: Implement a function that takes two numbers as input and returns the result of subtracting the second number from the first. Handle edge cases appropriately.
T3.notes: Ensure the function is robust against invalid inputs.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a function that multiplies two numbers and returns the product. Handle potential issues with large numbers.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop a function that divides the first number by the second and returns the quotient. Include error handling for division by zero.
T5.notes: Ensure proper error messages for invalid operations.

T6.implementation_approach: Connect the UI with the backend logic using event listeners for button clicks. Update the display area with results from arithmetic operations.
T6.notes: Ensure seamless interaction between UI and backend.

T7.implementation_approach: Write unit tests for each arithmetic function and integration tests for the UI. Use a testing framework to automate the tests.
T7.notes: Aim for high test coverage and include edge cases.

T8.implementation_approach: Deploy the application to a web server or cloud platform. Ensure the application is accessible and performs well under load.
T8.notes: Consider using CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment.
